qualifiers.condition: the default maximum record size of a stream is 1 MiB, and you update the stream's maximum record size limit to use large records; Kinesis handles intermittent large records (1-10MiB in size) using burst capacity

evidence.quote: | PutRecords |  | Each PutRecords request can support up to 500 records. Each record in the request can be as large as 10 MiB, up to a limit of 10 MiB for the entire request, including partition keys. Each shard can support writes up to 1,000 records per second, up to a maximum data write total of 1 MB per second.  |  Kinesis is designed to handle intermittent large records (1-10MiB in size) using burst capacity. |

evidence.quote: The following section describes the limits for the KDS data plane APIs. KDS data plane APIs enable you to use your data streams for collecting and processing data records in real time. These limits apply per shard within your data streams.
The default maximum record size for existing, and newly created streams is set to 1 MiB.
To start using large records in your stream, update your stream's maximum record size limit.
